narrative.purpose: 以真实门店素材构成可编辑的动态素材墙，分类与同一卡片放大播放引导无口播观看。
information_hierarchy: 分类、选中和同卡变形形成清楚路径
品牌、短标题与结尾邀请
structure: 机器人卡展开播放返回

scenes.purpose: 卡片级联进入，形成素材墙
选择门头卡片、同卡放大、原片播放并缩回
切换机器人分类，已有卡片重排
选择机器狗卡片并完成展开播放返回
选择儿童卡片并完成展开播放返回
完整墙与结尾邀请，保持可读停留

technical.note: 本期1920x1080/30fps/840帧/28.0秒，H264 yuv420p视频流20,493,490bps，AAC48kHz立体声，-15.21LUFS/-2.16dBTP，完整解码通过。

platform.note: 本轮不发布；真实平台UI和设备呈现独立待验。

custom.rules: 8张卡是同一组件的具名实例；每个cardId将封面、原片、文字、分类、几何和返回位置绑定。所有像素与曲线以layout.json/index.tsx为真值，规格box仅为当前示例快照。子元素随已列父卡存在；各scene列常驻根与该段动态对象，完整子元素清单在首次cascade声明。素材墙是视频设计，不证明线上软件功能。
custom.dormant_inputs: 当前适配器不开放card.preview；本期封面静止，只有选中展开卡播放原片。

material_edit.source_ranges: Cards bind original source and poster timestamps; moments bind real sourceOffset and continuous video coverage over [expandFrom,end). Poster source SHA, timestamp and poster SHA must match current receipt.
material_edit.cut_policy: Original-rate muted playback through expansion,hold and return. No freeze/loop/speed change to fill gaps. Moment phase endpoints are strict and selected intervals do not overlap.

graphic.text_policy: Editable current title/card/category/brand/closing text; actual-font fit and encoded readability after schema limits. Preserve factual qualifiers and source labels.
graphic.asset_fit: Card posters use declared imageFit/imagePosition; selected expanded video always contain. Original subject/doorframe preservation is verified on actual output frames.

speech_free.rules: Only master.wav music+SFX is rendered. Every original video is muted. No narration, ASR, TTS or avatar slot.

operations.input: Current props/source map/title, originals, poster files and exact extraction identities, master and review receipts.
operations.action: Validate files, category/card references, moment state ordering and original source coverage; freeze all media and implementation hashes.
operations.output: Original frozen request and verified source copies.
operations.completion: Required files exist and match actual review; all8 posters bind proper original SHA/time; master sample clock exact; no narration, source speech, cloud calls or publication.
operations.recovery: Restore same-SHA sources or repair exact changed inputs; new source/poster/timeline creates a fresh frozen request.

operations.input: Original frozen request and its dedicated queue job.
operations.action: Submit idempotently via studio_investment_recompose/store-material-wall-v1; registered worker invokes VideoCompose/Remotion, final encoding and QA.
operations.output: Actual complete wall video, quality/result records and candidate work identity.
operations.completion: Queue and media match request; dimensions/time/frames correct, complete decode, video stream>=20Mbps and AAC true peak<=-1.5dBTP.
operations.recovery: Read original job and completed artifacts before retry; runtime or input change requires a new frozen version.

operations.input: Encoded video, frozen current props, source/poster review, phase table and audio tracks.
operations.action: Inspect all phase boundaries and moving midpoints, stable same-card playback, complete motion replay and separately recorded sound/device checks.
operations.output: Actual inspected-frame/playback scope, final hashes and playable handoff.
operations.completion: Every applicable dimension has evidence; static image/schema/file/queue status does not substitute motion or listening acceptance.
operations.recovery: Locate exact card, source and output frame; repair the authoritative field, preserve prior version and recheck affected/related phases.
